layman_headline: Portfolio is treading water in a fearful market — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a 'Fear' state with Bitcoin down about 3% over the past week and altcoins broadly weak. We currently hold three positions — Solana, Chainlink, and FET — all slightly underwater but well within their stop-loss ranges. None of the new swing candidates offer a compelling risk-reward setup: the big movers (AKE, VELVET, Humanity) are overextended after massive rallies, while the rest lack clear technical signals. There's no reason to rush into a new trade when the market isn't offering an edge.
layman_action: Hold your current positions and wait. All three trades are still within their planned ranges. Don't add new risk until the market gives a clearer signal — either a bounce from deeper fear levels or a breakout with volume.
expert_reasoning: All three existing positions are within acceptable drawdown ranges and above their stop-losses. The swing candidates present poor setups: AKE has RSI at 91.72 after a 148% weekly run — textbook overbought. VELVET dropped 9.4% in 24h after a 126% weekly rally, signaling distribution. LINK is already held. The remaining candidates (INJ, TRUMP, SOL, H) lack RSI data and clear technical setups. With BTC dominance at 56.1% and Fear & Greed at 34, this is an unfavorable environment for new alt entries. The prudent move is to hold existing positions and wait for either a deeper selloff creating better entries or a sentiment shift above 45.
risk_factors: The $48B Bitcoin leverage trap (CryptoSlate) could trigger a sharp move in either direction, potentially hitting stop-losses on all positions simultaneously
BTC dominance at 56.1% continues to compress alt valuations — further BTC dominance expansion would pressure SOL, LINK, and FET
Fear & Greed at 34 with flat week-over-week trend suggests no imminent sentiment reversal
watch_list: BTC price action around $60,000 support — a break below would likely trigger cascading alt selloffs and hit our stops
Fear & Greed index movement — a drop below 25 could signal capitulation and better entry points; a rise above 40 would support current holds
LINK holding above $9.00 support — it had the strongest 7-day move (+13%) among quality alts but is now pulling back
market_context: The crypto market is in a cautious 'Fear' state with BTC at $63K and declining 3.2% weekly. High BTC dominance at 56.1% signals capital rotation away from alts, making new alt entries risky until sentiment shifts.
context_banner: Market in fear-driven consolidation — existing positions are intact but no new setups meet our risk-reward threshold this cycle.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 34 ('Fear') with improving trend from 30.3 weekly avg — not yet at capitulation levels that produce the best contrarian entries.
FET RSI at 38.96 is the only candidate approaching oversold territory; all high-momentum candidates (AKE at 91.7, VELVET at 60.2) are overbought.
A $48B Bitcoin leverage trap report suggests significant forced liquidation risk if BTC breaks key price boundaries, warranting caution on new entries.
Reporting investors are shifting back to fundamentals over market-cap rankings — supports holding quality positions (LINK, SOL) over chasing momentum plays.
BTC dominance at 56.1% remains elevated, historically unfavorable for alt season setups and supporting a defensive posture on alt positions.
